card.name: Section breaks in oncology warnings summaries
card.fires_on: Punctuation or bullet marks that close a section reference like (2.3, 5.1) in the highlights of cancer-drug labels, just before the next warning heading. Also fires on a few linking words inside toxicity sentences.

modes.label: After section reference
modes.description: The closing parenthesis or bullet after a numbered cross-reference, right before the next warning title.

modes.label: Linking word in toxicity text
modes.description: A verb or linking word leading into a toxicity or risk phrase for a cancer drug.
